# Mnema
Mnema is a learning platform under active development. The current signed-in experience supports private decks, learning materials, exercises, Study and owned media.

## Key Pages
- https://mnema.app/
- https://mnema.app/privacy
- https://mnema.app/terms

## Notes
- Private deck, authoring, media and Study pages require a Mnema account.
- The old public deck catalogue, template, import and AI pages are not part of the current runtime.
